npcs.name: Commander Valeria
npcs.description: A stern Celestial warden reviewing tactical displays.

dialogue.fiction:
Commander Valeria looks up from the tactical display as you approach.

'Good. You're here. The situation in Vorath's Reach has escalated. The Hegemony's listening post — K'tharr's operation — sits atop something significant. An Ancient archive that could shift the balance of power.'

She gestures to the holographic star-map, where a crimson marker pulses in the Vorath system.

'We're calling this Operation Echoes in the Void. Your team will gate to Waystation Vorath, scout the Listening Post, and neutralize the threat. Extract with any archive data you can recover.'

She crosses her arms. 'Choose your approach.'

options.text: Social engineering — talk our way in

npcs.name: Lieutenant Kael
npcs.description: A sharp-eyed operations officer monitoring mission status boards.

dialogue.fiction:
Lieutenant Kael glances up from a holo-tablet as you approach.

'Officer. Good to see you. Need a rundown on how Guardian Command runs its missions?'

He taps the display, bringing up a mission flowchart.

'Every mission starts with an **engagement roll** — rolled against the crew's best action rating. The result determines if you start clean or with a complication.'

'Once you're in the field, you'll face **challenges** — each has a progress clock. Pick an action, pick a character, roll. Critical = 4 ticks. Full = 2 ticks. Partial = 1 tick. Failure = 0 ticks. Each action has a single consequence that triggers on failure. When a challenge clock fills, it's done. When *all* challenges in a scene are done, the scene resolves and you move to the next.'

'Complete all scenes in a mission, and you get the **payoff** — coin and rep. But you also take **heat** based on the worst action outcome, plus the mission's base heat. Your patron faction likes you more; the target faction likes you less.'

'Want me to walk through any of that in more detail?'

Kael pulls up a diagram of the engagement table.

'**Engagement Roll** — roll your crew's best action rating. Count 6s, 4-5s, 1-3s.'

'• **Critical** (two or more 6s) → Best outcome, no complication.
• **Full Success** (one 6) → Clean success, no complication.
• **Partial Success** (4-5, no 6s) → Success but with a complication from the GM.
• **Failure** (1-3 only) → The engagement falters.'

'After the engagement roll, you gate to the mission's starting location and the first scene activates automatically.'

Kael swipes to a challenge breakdown.

'**Challenges** are the obstacles in each scene. Each has:
• A description
• A progress clock (usually 4-6 segments)
• Tags (for stunts/items)
• Action entries — each lists an action name and a single consequence (failure only)'

'**Resolution**:
1. Pick a challenge
2. Pick an action entry from that challenge
3. Assign a character
4. The engine gathers applicable stunts + items (tags matching scene + challenge)
5. Roll: action dots + bonus dice - condition penalties - harm penalties
6. Outcome ticks the clock (critical=4, full=2, partial=1, failure=0) or applies consequence on failure

'**Consequences** use templates — harm (reduces Guard then Body), condition (adds a condition tag that takes a load slot), tickClock (advances the mission danger clock), or loseItem. Consequences only trigger on failure.'

Kael brings up the mission ledger.

'**Mission Completion** triggers automatically when all scenes resolve:

• **Payoff**: Coin and Rep added to crew immediately
• **Heat**: Max action heat from the mission + base heat. Each action entry has a heat value (default 3). Adjustment by outcome: failure=full, partial/success=−1, critical=−2.
• **Faction Standing**: Patron faction +1 status, target faction -1 status
• **Custom onComplete**: Any mission-specific callback fires.

'**Claims** are territorial holdings you can take during downtime. They use formula templates — income, rep_boost, heat_sink, upgrade_slot, faction_contact, territory_control, crew_stunt, lair_room, bonus_payout. Some have prerequisites (other claims).

'**Downtime** between missions: each character gets 2 activities — recovery (tick healing clock), rest (clear conditions), training (spend XP to raise action), long-term project (advance a clock).

'That's the cycle. Engagement → Scenes → Challenges → Completion → Payoff/Heat → Downtime → Repeat.'

plotlines.name: Echoes in the Void
plotlines.description: Investigate Hegemony activity in Vorath's Reach and neutralize Agent K'tharr's operation.

scenes.fiction:
You gather the team at the operations center's gate terminal. The Vorath portal hums with contained energy.

Valeria's voice crackles over the comm: 'Hammerfall, you're green for departure. The gate is calibrated for Waystation Vorath. Once you step through, the operation is live.'

The air shimmers as the gate runes cycle to full brightness. Time to commit to your approach.

hooks.text: The team steps through the gate in silence, emerging at Waystation Vorath under cover of darkness.
The team charges through the gate, weapons hot, emerging at Waystation Vorath with guns blazing.

options.text: Social engineering — talk our way in

hooks.text: The team steps through the gate posing as Hegemony supply runners, emerging at Waystation Vorath.

scenes.fiction:
You emerge onto the moon's surface. The Listening Post is a black needle against the starfield, its spires crackling with void-shields. Between you and the facility lies a kilometer of jagged razorgrass and shattered Ancient statuary. Hegemony patrol drones trace lazy arcs overhead.

Time to find a path in.

challenges.description: Survey the perimeter and find a safe approach.

consequences.description: Patrol drones detect you — alarm raised.
You trigger a tripwire, alerting the facility.
Your flawed analysis sends the team into an ambush.

scenes.fiction:
The Listening Post's interior is a cathedral of alien design. Bio-silk membranes pulse with dim light. Rhukothi runes crawl along the walls like living things. Two obstacles stand between you and the archive: a sealed security door of crystalline Hegemony design, and a patrol of thrall guards in the central chamber beyond.

You'll need to overcome both to reach the archive core.

challenges.description: A crystalline Hegemony security door — requires technical skill or precision manipulation to bypass.

onComplete.text: Security door bypassed. Path to the central chamber is open.

challenges.description: A squad of thrall guards patrols the central chamber. Avoid or neutralize them.

consequences.description: A guard spots movement — alarm raised.
Your authority is challenged — guards attack.

onEnter.text: The team enters the Listening Post.

scenes.fiction:
The archive core opens into a vast chamber. At its center, floating above a plinth of carved obsidian, is Agent K'tharr — a Rhukothi sorceress in robes of living shadow. She turns as you enter, eight eyes glowing with cold amusement.

'I was wondering when the Celestials would send their hounds,' she hisses. 'This archive holds secrets that predate your precious Havens. Secrets that will reshape the Verse.'

Her hands crackle with entropic energy. The archive's power core thrums in response.

options.text: Attempt to negotiate — offer her safe passage
Sabotage the archive core and escape

scenes.fiction:
K'tharr unleashes a wave of entropic force. The archive shakes as she levitates debris and hurls it at your team. Her shadow-form flickers between corporeal and immaterial, making her a difficult target.

'You will die here, and your knowledge will feed the archive!'

challenges.description: Defeat Agent K'tharr before she completes her ritual.

consequences.description: Your shot hits the power core — collateral damage.
K'tharr turns her fury on you.
Her psychic assault shatters your concentration.

scenes.fiction: The mission clock is ticking. With the archive destabilized and Hegemony reinforcements on approach, you must hold your position long enough for the extraction shuttle to lock onto your beacon. Thrall soldiers pour into the facility. This is the final stand.

challenges.description: Hold the extraction point until the shuttle arrives.

consequences.description: You take a direct hit from thrall fire.

onComplete.text: Extraction successful. The team escapes Vorath's Reach.

onExit.text: The team returns to Guardian Nexus Operations.
